medicina.name: Medicine
medicina.short: You learn how the human body works and how diseases are treated.
medicina.admission: Usually a written exam in biology and chemistry or physics, plus the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

medicina-dentara.name: Dental Medicine
medicina-dentara.short: You learn to treat teeth and the mouth, with precision and a steady hand.
medicina-dentara.admission: Usually a written exam in biology and chemistry or physics; some faculties may also ask for a practical test. Check the faculty's website.

farmacie.name: Pharmacy
farmacie.short: You learn how medicines are made and how to use them safely.
farmacie.admission: Usually an exam in chemistry and biology, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), depending on the faculty. Check the faculty's website.

medicina-veterinara.name: Veterinary Medicine
medicina-veterinara.short: You learn to care for and treat animals, from cats to cows.
medicina-veterinara.admission: Usually an exam in biology or chemistry, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

asistenta-medicala.name: Nursing
asistenta-medicala.short: You learn to care for patients and to work alongside doctors.
asistenta-medicala.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a biology test. Check the faculty's website.

informatica.name: Computer Science
informatica.short: You learn programming, algorithms and how to solve problems with a computer.
informatica.admission: Usually an exam in mathematics or computer science, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

calculatoare-it.name: Computers and IT
calculatoare-it.short: You learn how computers, networks and applications are built.
calculatoare-it.admission: Usually an exam in mathematics and physics or computer science, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

inginerie-electrica-electronica.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
inginerie-electrica-electronica.short: You learn how electric current, circuits and electronic devices work.
inginerie-electrica-electronica.admission: Usually an exam in mathematics and physics, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

inginerie-mecanica.name: Mechanical Engineering
inginerie-mecanica.short: You learn how machines, engines and equipment are designed.
inginerie-mecanica.admission: Usually an exam in mathematics and physics, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

inginerie-civila.name: Civil Engineering
inginerie-civila.short: You learn to design and build buildings, bridges and roads.
inginerie-civila.admission: Usually an exam in mathematics, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes technical drawing too. Check the faculty's website.

arhitectura.name: Architecture
arhitectura.short: You learn to draw and design buildings and cities that are beautiful and useful.
arhitectura.admission: Usually aptitude tests, especially drawing, which may be combined with the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

inginerie-chimica-materiale.name: Chemical Engineering and Materials
inginerie-chimica-materiale.short: You learn how plastic, metal and other materials are made and improved.
inginerie-chimica-materiale.admission: Usually an exam in chemistry or mathematics, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

energie-petrol-mediu.name: Energy, Petroleum and Environment
energie-petrol-mediu.short: You learn how energy is produced and how to protect nature at the same time.
energie-petrol-mediu.admission: Usually an exam in mathematics or physics, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

matematica.name: Mathematics
matematica.short: You learn theories and methods for solving hard problems with numbers and logic.
matematica.admission: Usually an exam in mathematics, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

fizica.name: Physics
fizica.short: You learn the laws of nature, from atoms to stars.
fizica.admission: Usually an exam in physics and mathematics, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

chimie.name: Chemistry
chimie.short: You learn what things are made of and how they change into one another.
chimie.admission: Usually an exam in chemistry, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

biologie.name: Biology
biologie.short: You learn about plants, animals, cells and how life works.
biologie.admission: Usually an exam in biology, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

geografie-mediu.name: Geography and Environment
geografie-mediu.short: You learn about landforms, climate, cities and how we can protect the planet.
geografie-mediu.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a geography test. Check the faculty's website.

agronomie-silvicultura.name: Agronomy and Forestry
agronomie-silvicultura.short: You learn to grow plants, raise crops and look after forests.
agronomie-silvicultura.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a biology or chemistry test. Check the faculty's website.

economie-finante.name: Economics and Finance
economie-finante.short: You learn how money, banks, markets and a country's economy work.
economie-finante.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a mathematics exam. Check the faculty's website.

business-management.name: Business and Management
business-management.short: You learn to lead a team and to start or grow a business.
business-management.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes an interview or a test. Check the faculty's website.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.short: You learn to make people discover and want a product or an idea.
marketing.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes an interview. Check the faculty's website.

drept.name: Law
drept.short: You learn the laws and how people's rights are defended.
drept.admission: Usually a general knowledge test or a test in Romanian language and history, or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

stiinte-politice-relatii-internationale.name: Political Science and International Relations
stiinte-politice-relatii-internationale.short: You learn how states are governed and how countries work together.
stiinte-politice-relatii-internationale.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a history or foreign language test. Check the faculty's website.

administratie-publica.name: Public Administration
administratie-publica.short: You learn how town halls, ministries and public services work.
administratie-publica.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

comunicare-jurnalism.name: Communication and Journalism
comunicare-jurnalism.short: You learn to write, to speak and to tell stories in the press and online.
comunicare-jurnalism.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a general culture test or an essay. Check the faculty's website.

psihologie.name: Psychology
psihologie.short: You learn how people think, feel and behave.
psihologie.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a knowledge test or an interview. Check the faculty's website.

sociologie-asistenta-sociala.name: Sociology and Social Work
sociologie-asistenta-sociala.short: You learn how people live in a community and how to help them when they need it.
sociologie-asistenta-sociala.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

stiintele-educatiei.name: Educational Sciences
stiintele-educatiei.short: You learn how children learn and how to be a good teacher.
stiintele-educatiei.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a Romanian language test or an interview. Check the faculty's website.

litere-limbi-straine.name: Literature and Foreign Languages
litere-limbi-straine.short: You study languages, literature and translation.
litere-limbi-straine.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a test in Romanian or in the chosen foreign language. Check the faculty's website.

istorie.name: History
istorie.short: You learn what happened in the past and why today's world looks the way it does.
istorie.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a history test. Check the faculty's website.

filosofie.name: Philosophy
filosofie.short: You learn to ask big questions and to think clearly about them.
filosofie.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes an essay or an interview. Check the faculty's website.

teologie.name: Theology
teologie.short: You study religion, its history and its role in people's lives.
teologie.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes an interview or a recommendation, depending on the denomination. Check the faculty's website.

arte-vizuale-design.name: Visual Arts and Design
arte-vizuale-design.short: You learn to draw, to paint and to create original images and objects.
arte-vizuale-design.admission: Usually aptitude tests, for example drawing or a portfolio, which may be combined with the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

muzica.name: Music
muzica.short: You learn to play, to compose and to understand music at a high level.
muzica.admission: Usually aptitude tests, such as performance on an instrument or singing and music theory, plus the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

teatru-film.name: Theatre and Film
teatru-film.short: You learn to act, to direct and to make films or stage shows.
teatru-film.admission: Usually aptitude tests and auditions, plus the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

sport-kinetoterapie.name: Sport and Physiotherapy
sport-kinetoterapie.short: You learn about movement, training and how to help people recover.
sport-kinetoterapie.admission: Usually sports or aptitude tests, plus the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac); a medical certificate is sometimes required too. Check the faculty's website.

militar-politie.name: Military and Police
militar-politie.short: You prepare for a career in the army, the police or the defence of the country.
militar-politie.admission: Usually physical tests, a medical and psychological check and a written test, plus the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac). Check the faculty's website.

marina-transporturi.name: Maritime and Transport
marina-transporturi.short: You learn to operate ships and to organise the transport of people and goods.
marina-transporturi.admission: Usually an exam in mathematics or the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), plus a medical check. Check the faculty's website.

turism-servicii.name: Tourism and Services
turism-servicii.short: You learn to organise trips, hotels and experiences for people.
turism-servicii.admission: Usually the average grade from the Romanian Baccalaureate (bac), sometimes a foreign language test. Check the faculty's website.
